en: I hate Nezha most! He's always bullying me...
Li Jing has two other kids, Jinzha and Muzha. They're nothing like Nezha at all. How did Lord Li Jing end up with him?
This is the Li residence. What do you want?
We're Nezha's friends! We want to see Li Jing!
Insolent thugs! Calling Lord Li Jing by name? You're clearly trouble. Leave at once...
Hey, watchdog, are you tired of living or what...
Just as I thought! A foul-mouthed freak bird, the young master's friend? Hardly!
Why you...
Beakface, shut it!
Big bro! Maybe you'd better do the talking!
I am Ji Fa, son of the Lord of the West, and these are my brothers. We're no outlaws. Forgive our rudeness, and kindly inform Lord Li Jing...
The Lord of the West!! Y-yes... I-I'll tell him... right away...
Please forgive my rudeness just now...
Hmph! That guy...
Please forgive my rudeness just now...
The master and lady are in the guest room!
Young Master Nezha has been gone so long. Where could he be?
I hope Young Master Nezha behaves. The master's going gray over that little troublemaker...
A bird? No pets allowed in the Li residence!
Pets? You don't mean me, do you?
Ah! The b-b-bird... it t-talks...
Young Master Nezha's been gone so long. The lady's worried...
Let me go in alone!
Pingyan... All right. Go in by yourself.
I am Li Jing. I hear you're friends of my son?
Nezha? Why didn't Nezha come back with you?
Don't worry, dear. Let's hear what the lad has to say.
Y-you... you're saying... Nezha is... d-dead!
My lady, are you all right?!
Someone! Help my wife inside to rest...
I think I understand the whole story now.
It's all my fault! He did it for me...

It was that boy's fate. You're not to blame... To think he was so loyal to his friends. He was always causing trouble, but... today I, Li Jing, am proud of Nezha. He died for a worthy cause... The Phoenix Bone you seek is on Mount Wufeng. But be careful: a Phoenix Sage guards Mount Wufeng. Do take care!
Thank you, sir!
Nezha will always be my best friend!
Mount Wufeng is northeast! You'll pass Qingfeng Village on the way!
Let your wife rest. Don't disturb her...
Welcome to Qingfeng Village!
There's Qingfeng Lake east of the village! The scenery is gorgeous!
I heard a strange noise at Qingfeng Lake. Check it out if you're passing by!
Our red maples are famous, hence the name Qingfeng, 'Clear Maple'!
Did you know? There's a Trial Cave near Qingfeng Village! Don't miss it!
Mount Jialong is the main road from Xiqi to Zhaoge.
Shaobai...
Haven't seen Nezha around in a while...
Want to hear Xiaoyu's story?
Never mind, then!

Ten years ago, Xiaoyu met a fox spirit, Shaobai. They lived like immortal lovers, but it didn't last... Her parents had a Taoist seal the fox away... They told her Shaobai was dead, and soon after, she took her own life...
Then what's in front of us is...
Yes! It's Xiaoyu's longing... She believes Shaobai will come for her...
Is there any way to set her free?
Take our family's Dragon-Breaking Seal! Shaobai is said to be sealed on Mount Jialong. Use this at the seal to break it... Find Shaobai, and Xiaoyu can rest in peace...
Xiaoyu? Shaobai? Sounds familiar... C-could it be the fox and girl from the Mengxiang barbershop...?
Please help Shaobai! He's deep in Flying Dragon Cave on Mount Jialong...
Got summon beast: Bloodgnat!
Heh heh! Don't ignore us, sweetie~
C'mon~ come with us!
Catching the eye of us five brothers is your lucky day!
Deep down you're thrilled, aren't ya!
I'd let go now if I were you...
Hee hee... Nope, not letting go!
You puny grunts? I wouldn't even give you a second look...
Ooh~ I'm sooo scared~
Then go and die...!
Help me~! Isn't there a hero out there to save little me~
Why'd her attitude suddenly change...
Looks like a girl's being harassed by demons. Let's go save her!
Well said~ Go get 'em, Beakface!
Are you all right, miss?
Thank you for saving me, hero! My name is Yang...
Waah~! A demon~!
Die! You bastards!
You're obviously demons!
Trying to fool me by taking human form?
Huff~ huff~
C-could you be a little reasonable? If we were demons, would we have saved you from demons?
!! Oh, right!
Unbelievable! That's what I get for being nice...
Sorry~! I didn't mean to~ It's his fault...
You again! Beakface, that ugly mug of yours always drags us down!
Oh, so now it's my fault! Should've minded my own business!
Okay, okay! Pingyan, cool it.
Brother Leizhenzi~ don't be mad~ I'm sorry~ You're a big man, so don't be angry with little old me~
...O-okay... fine... I forgive you! My master says a real man never fights girls.
Thank you, Brother Leizhenzi~
Brother Ji Fa, don't take it to heart either!
I won't. It was just a misunderstanding...
Hmph! Like I'd forgive you that easily...
Don't be like that~ Brother Pingyan~
No way!
Listen, punk! Don't push your luck! Wanna bet I can take you apart in two seconds?
N-nothing! I just said, Brother Ji, don't be so mean to me. You're scaring me!
You witch! Sneak attack me, will you? I'll teach you a lesson...
What are you doing, Beakface!
Boo~ hoo~ hoo hoo~ I... I just...
Beanpole! Picking on a girl? Call yourself a man?
Exactly~ That's what I said~
B-but that woman...
Pingyan! She's a cute girl, you know. A gentleman should treat a lady gently!
Hee hee...
Hmph!
Oh right! May we ask your name, miss?
You can call me Yang Jian. Nice to meet you!
Yang Jian!? The god Erlang, Yang Jian!?
To thank you for rescuing me, I'll go with you to Mount Wufeng! I know it really well...
Really? That's wonderful!
Hmph! More like you'll just get in our way!
Beanpole, get over here!
Don't you think she's cute?
Are you a moron? Erlang Yang Jian is a grown man! You think that cross-dresser is cute?
What!? A m-man... you're kidding, right...

Hey! I heard that! Whisper when you badmouth a girl! Lots of people think I'm a man, but that's because I'm a master of transformation. A frail girl traveling alone has to dress as a guy to stay safe!
I-is that so? S-so Erlang is actually a girl...? This is...
Don't overthink it, Beanpole! It's settled!
You're very welcome to join us... right, Second Bro?
Mm! Absolutely!
Hmph! Do whatever you want! I don't care!
This is Mount Wufeng. Deep inside lives the Phoenix Sage. To get the Phoenix Bone, we must get past him first...
I am the Phoenix Sage, guardian of Mount Wufeng.
I am the Phoenix Sage, guardian of Mount Wufeng. What brings you here?
We wanna borrow a Phoenix Bone! We'll give it back when we're done, so don't be stingy!
Is that how you ask a favor? Besides, the Phoenix Bone is this mountain's sacred relic. You can't just take it...
Beakface! Look, you've ruined it again! Let me handle this...
Wh-what are you doing?
Shut your yap!
You...

Phoenix Sage~ Let little me explain. The Ancient South is gravely wounded, and to save him we need your Phoenix Bone to brew an elixir. I know it's an outrageous request, but a life is at stake, so I have no choice but to beg you... Boo hoo hoo hoo~
Sniff! Why didn't you say so~ If the Ancient South is in danger, I can't stand by! D-don't cry~ The bone is yours...
Thank you... thank you so much... boo hoo~
Got Phoenix Bone!
I'll never forget you as long as I live...
I hope my Phoenix Bone helps...
Thanks to Yang Jian, getting the Phoenix Bone went so smoothly...
Brother Leizhenzi~ don't say that~ You'll make me blush...
S-somebody just strangle me now...
Did you say something just now?
I said you're amazing~ Let's get going!
That's more like it! Now you've seen what I can do! Ha ha ha~
Oh no! I just meant...
I'll be taking this! Ho ho! I'm getting married! I'm getting a wife!
Ah! The Ph-Phoenix Bone...
After him! What are you standing around for!
Save your strength! We'll never catch him now!
So we just let it go?
That jerk snatched the Phoenix Bone right out of my hands! You think I'll let that slide? He ignored me!
Yang Jian is scary...

N-no! I meant the Phoenix Bone is vital to saving the Ancient South. It can't stay in a crook's hands! That was Tu Xingsun, Juliusun's star pupil. Their hideout is Flying Dragon Cave on Mount Jialong, just southeast! Let's go!
'We'? Does that 'we' include you?
Of course!
You said you'd come with us to Mount Wufeng. Mission accomplished! You can go now! Buh-bye...
Boo~ hoo~ hoo~ I'm the one who lost the Phoenix Bone. How could I just walk away...
Cut the sob story!
Beanpole! How can you bully Miss Yang Jian like that!
Me? I'M the bully?
Ignore Beanpole! Let's go!
Boo~ hoo~ hoo~
I think she's a good kid. Pingyan, don't be so hard on her!
Second Bro, I...
Let's go, Pingyan!
Want me to strangle you for real? Hee hee hee!
Welcome to Mengxia Village.
Go further south and you'll reach Mount Jialong!
Heard about Shaobai and Xiaoyu of Qingfeng Village? So tragic!
I wish someone would love me the way Shaobai did...
They say Shaobai is sealed in Flying Dragon Cave on Mount Jialong!
Northeast of the village is the Yellow Turban Grotto. A Yellow Turban warrior lives there, and he's super strong!
Mount Jialong is the main road from Xiqi to Zhaoge.
Tu Xingsun is a kind soul. I hear he's smitten with some girl lately...
I think her name was Deng... Hee hee~ I forgot!
Better not rush in...
What do you want with me?
Well, on the way to Mount Jialong a huge boulder is blocking the road. They say you're super strong, so we hoped you could move it for us...
But first you must pass my test...
Got it!
Very good! If you ever need help, just say the word...
Thanks a lot!
Got summon beast: Golden Strongman!
Sorry I kept you waiting, Xiaoyu... I'm back...
Sh-Shaobai, it's really you... You came back for me... I knew you would... Father said you were dead...
How could I die? Didn't I promise to stay by your side, life after life?
Sob... Shaobai... I knew you wouldn't leave me. Seeing you again... I have no regrets...
I know... I know everything... You've suffered so much...
Shaobai... I think it's time we let this life's bond go... We belong to different worlds now...
What are you saying? Even if our bond in this life is over... even if I wait thousands of years, I'll find you... sob~
Shaobai... that's enough... Promise me~ promise you'll live on... When I'm reborn... come find me...
Xiaoyu~ I'll find you, I swear... Sob sob sob~
Xiaoyu... Shaobai...
Thank you, kid...
You're Shaobai from the Mengxiang barbershop?
Yes! No matter what, I had to thank my benefactor...
I thought you were badly wounded... How can you still travel to this era?
This is the very last of my strength. I had to come to this era and thank you in person, for setting Xiaoyu's soul free...
B-but then... you won't be able to go back to the present and find Xiaoyu...
It's all right! Because... I've already found her...
May you two grow old together...
Now it's time I kept my promise to the Fulong Sage...
Sh-Shaobai... what are you...
This is to repay the Fulong Sage... Thank you, kid... I'll go back to the mountains to train, and wait for Xiaoyu's rebirth...
A fox that loves like that... it puts us humans to shame. What a beautiful, tragic love story...
...As a woman, with a lover like that, I could die without regrets...
Thank you for freeing Xiaoyu's soul. Please take this Idler's Token! If you collect the Townsman's Token too, it's sure to come in handy someday...
If you collect the Townsman's Token too, it's sure to come in handy someday...
Got Idler's Token!
20 silver per night.
Can I help you?
Not far west of the village is the Jiuwan River. It's beautiful! Go see it if you have time!
They say a Dragon God lives in the Dragon God Cave.
They say the Dragon God Cave collapsed, and the Dragon God is dead...
I'm sure someone will bring peace to these chaotic times...
They say deep in the Forest of No Return to the northwest, there's a summon beast!
Why are there more and more demons lately? Is the world about to fall into chaos...
I'm so jealous of King Zhou and his 3,000 beauties.
They say Li Jing's wife was pregnant for 3 and a half years, then gave birth to a ball of flesh... Horrible.
That's right! They say Li Jing cut the ball open on the spot, and he and his wife were shocked to find a child inside... That child was Li Nezha!
What now? We've got no leads on the Dragon Sinew or Phoenix Bone...
I'm so hungry~
Beakface~ give it a rest! We've done nothing yet and your stomach's already whining... Grumble... grumble...
And whose stomach was that, huh? Talk about hypocrites!
Y-you shut up!
Um... my little brothers...
Second Bro, stay out of this! Beakface, listen...
I'm... in the way?
Hey! Hey! Beanpole, smell that!
Th-that smell... Someone's cooking something!
Let's go ask him for some food!
Hey, kid! We're starving to death. Could you spare us some fish?
I said, kid, could you spare us some fish?
Hey, kid! Are you looking down on people?
People? I only see a weird-beaked bird. No people here!
Ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha~
Y-you... you dare look down on me, Leizhenzi!
Wh-why you~! I'll slaughter you...
You can't...
Beakface! Stop!
Sorry, my underling was very rude!
Un-underling? Who's YOUR underling, Beanpole! It's your fault! You keep calling me Beakface, and now others do too...
Finally, someone with some sense.
Sorry, but we're really starving. Could you share some food with us?
All that's left is fish bones, if you want them that badly...
Sob~ what do we do now... I don't even have the strength to walk back...
You lousy brat! You ate my best friend... I won't let you get away with it!
You guys go on ahead. This is my problem. I'll handle it myself!
Yeah! Beanpole, let's just leave him...
What are you saying, Beakface! We can't just run off like that!
Heh! You really love sticking your nose in, huh! Ha ha... then thanks in advance, brother!
Don't mention it! Meeting like this is fate! Besides, you called me brother! Brother!
Let's roast this big shrimp!
Great idea!
Beanpole! So that was your plan all along!
But is this really okay? Grumble grumble~
Don't fight your stomach, Second Bro!
B-but...
Enough with the buts. Come on!
What are you standing around for? Hurry up or I'm digging in!
Oh! Coming! Coming!
Is this really okay...? Gulp! Who cares! Hey! Save some for me!
Mmm... delicious!
So you're Li Nezha!
Thanks for your help back there, you and Brother Ji...
Um... aren't you forgetting someone?
So you're looking for the Dragon Sinew and the Phoenix Bone!
Hey, can't you hear someone talking to you?
What's that squawking... so noisy!
Y-you... you...
Beakface! We're talking business, so quit butting in!
He seems to know where they are. Just bear with it, little brother!
Hmph!
The fish monster and shrimp fiend we just ate were actually the East Sea Dragon King's minions. I doubt he'll let this go.
Wha--!! Th-this is bad!
Rather than wait for trouble, let's storm the East Sea Dragon Palace and rip out the Dragon King's sinew!
The Dragon Sinew's in the Dragon Palace? Sounds good... but ripping it out of a live Dragon King... is that wise?
See? See? I told you! This troublemaker killed the Dragon King's minions, and now wants us to rip out his sinew! A Dragon King's no small-fry demon! This is suicide!
And who was it that ate the most just now?
... Beanpole! Let's go! Destination: East Sea Dragon Palace!
That Beakface...
I knew there was no such thing as a free lunch.
Dive down here and you'll reach the East Sea Dragon Palace!
But how do we get down there?
Well...
Who's there? Who killed my brothers just now?
Ha ha... He'll take us to the East Sea Dragon Palace...
Isn't this straight out of some fairy tale? Ha ha... why overthink it?
Wh-what did you say? You want me to take you to the Dragon Palace?
That's right!
Are you kidding?! If I take you to the Dragon Palace, the Dragon King will kill me for sure!
Ha ha... the Dragon King can kill you, but you think I, Nezha, can't? If you refuse, I'll kill you right here and now!
Sob... well... fine! I've only got two options. Maybe if I take you there... I'll live a little longer... Hop on! I'll take you...
We're here! This is the East Sea Dragon Palace...
Thanks for the ride!
I just thought of it! There's a third option!
What?
Running away!
That guy... Hmph! Forget it! Let's keep going!
Yeah!
Li Nezha and Ji Pingyan? So you're the ones who killed my minions?
Relax! You're next! My brother needs to borrow your Dragon Sinew!
My sinew? Bold little brats. I was just about to send men to capture you, and here you are on my doorstep!
If you could guess what we were thinking, how embarrassing would that be!
Enough talk! I'll offer your blood as a sacrifice...
Okay, here's the Dragon Sinew. Let's get out of here!
It still feels a bit cruel, though! Taking his sinew is one thing, but did we have to kill him?
Brother, great men don't sweat the small stuff. If we soft-heartedly spared him, he'd never leave us alone. He'd be trouble forever!
... Now all that's left is the Phoenix Bone...
Wh-who are you? F-Father... You killed my father... I'll avenge him!
Look out, brother!
Brother... do you think I'm cruel? If he hadn't tried to hurt you...
No! Brother Nezha! You did it to save me. If anyone takes the blame, it's me. Come on! We still have to find the Phoenix Bone...
Sob sob~ Father, brother... I'll avenge you... Ji Pingyan, Li Nezha... You'll pay for this in blood!
Got summon beast: Leopard...
Wh-what did you say? Brother Ao and Ao Bing were killed, and Brother Ao's sinew was ripped out!
There's no mistake! I saw it with my own eyes! I'll never forget the faces of that Ji Pingyan and Li Nezha gang... Now the only one I can turn to is my father's dearest friend: you, Master Taiyi...
Ao Zhu! Rest easy! Brother Ao and I were close friends. If I don't avenge him, who will? Let's leave the mountain at once...
Thank you so much. I'm sure Father and my brother are smiling down from heaven, so happy to have had a friend like you... Sob sob sob~
My father Li Jing knows a lot. He might know where the Phoenix Bone is. Tell you what! Come hang out at my place!
Who wants to hang out at YOUR place!
Let's go, let's go! Hanging out at your place, awesome!
Leizhenzi, aren't you coming?
No! Who'd wanna go?
All right! Then we'll go on ahead...
... Wait for me!
It's them! They're the ones who killed my father and brother!
Wretched boys, so young and so brutal! Today I shall deliver heaven's justice!
Old man, have you lost your mind? We don't even know you...
Prepare to die!
Ugh... urgh...
So you die knowing why: Ao Guang and Ao Bing, whom you killed, were my dear friends, and the father and brother of Miss Ao Zhu here. Any last words!
That's not on us, it was all Li...
Shut up! Fine, then. I admit it! I killed them. A debt has its debtor. This has nothing to do with them...
You're all in on it. Not one of you escapes... Uncle Taiyi, kill them!
Brother!!
Nezha!!
Nezha!! You...
I... ripped out Ao Guang's sinew... I... killed Ao Bing... Blood for blood... is only... right. Let this feud... end here! Please... let them go...
Brother~
... This boy truly had a fiery heart.
Ao Zhu~ feuds are better ended than prolonged. Today Nezha paid with his life, so let this grudge be settled! Sigh...
Uncle Taiyi!
Ji Pingyan, you're guilty too! Prepare to die!
Sob... Father... brother... I'm useless, I couldn't avenge you... I'm coming to join you...
Miss Ao Zhu, please don't do this. I'm the one who wronged you...
Ji Pingyan, spare me your fake pity. I lost today, but just you wait. I won't let you off! Someday I'll tear you to pieces, for my father and brother in heaven...
Miss Ao Zhu...
He's all yours, Zhang Guifang!
No problem! Leave it to me!
Oh? Someone else who wants to die at Zhang Guifang's hands?
Are you Zhang Guifang? By my father's order, I've come for your head!
Ji Chang sends even his own kids to die? Ha ha ha~ Xiqi must be out of talent!
Hey watchdog! Done barking yet? Show us what you've got!
Out of the way! A good dog doesn't block the road...
Don't be so impatient! There's room in hell for everyone...
Then let's see if you've got what it takes!

Ha ha ha~ You don't know your limits! With skills like that you want to fight me? Laughable! Since they're Ji Chang's kids, I'll take them hostage. Then Xiqi will fall on its own! Men~ throw all the rebels in the dungeon!
Ugh~ damn it~
Looks like we really underestimated Zhang Guifang. What now... Everyone's in the dungeon... I wonder how they're doing?
Not only did I fail to avenge my wife, I've been captured too. Sigh...
Excuse me, who are you...
You must be the Xiqi soldiers who just fought Zhang Guifang! We're all as good as dead. Why bother with names...
Sounds like you're not from Xiqi? And don't be so gloomy~ If we swap names, we'll have company on the road to the underworld! Right?
I mean, we're definitely not dying here! My dad's surely working on a way to save us...
Your father is?
Oh right! Forgot to introduce myself. I'm Ji Pingyan, and my dad is Ji Chang, who's at war with Chong Houhu...

You're Ji Chang's son!? Wonderful! We're saved... wait! Sigh~ What am I hoping for? Even Ji Chang's kids are captured. His surrender is only a matter of time... No! There's still one! They say Prince Ji Fa is a master of pen and sword. Maybe he can beat Chong Houhu!
Mister~ I'd advise against pinning your hopes on my big bro Ji Fa...
What are you saying? Don't talk down your own side! Besides, Prince Ji Fa is famous all over Zhaoge!
Because big bro is in here too...

... Waah~ what am I doing? I never should've hoped! Defecting to Xiqi was a bad idea from day one! If only... when King Zhou and Daji killed my beloved wife, I hadn't lost my temper! If I'd swallowed my pride and stayed with King Zhou, I'd still be the mighty Huang Feihu, King of Wucheng! Now look at me, a prisoner!
Y-you're Huang... Huang Feihu!? The loyal, valiant King of Wucheng, Huang Feihu!? You're nothing like I imagined...
You talk like you know me well. Kid, I've never seen you before...
...Let's not get into that... Let's just figure out how to get out of here!
Hmph! If there were a way out, would I be standing here staring at you?
Don't give up so easily~ Just try~ Maybe our cell door isn't even locked...
Hmph! Kid, you're so naive! If anything that lucky ever happened, from then on I'd be your servant! I'd even call you Grandpa...
Good grandson~ now go help me find the key and let your grandpa's friends out...
Let's find the key first!
Ho ho ho~ Now the general's even caught Ji Chang's kids. We'll be marching home in no time!
Yeah! I miss Zhaoge too! I wonder if my wife and kids miss me... With me gone, they must cry every day! Hee hee hee...
Dream on! Your son's probably got a new daddy by now!
Y-you... you...
If you've got time to miss your families, go patrol some more. If they escape, it's our heads on the chopping block...
Yes sir!
Y-you... you...
H-how did you get out!
Me and my grandson strolled right out of our cell. Thanks to you two geniuses for not locking it...
N-not locked!? Didn't I tell you to lock it?
Didn't I tell YOU to?
